query:
SELECT a.id, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.therapyType, a.status, a.seriesId, p.name as patientName, u.name as therapistName
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
LEFT JOIN users u ON a.therapistUserId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%REGINA%'
AND a.startTime >= '2026-06-15'
AND a.startTime < '2026-06-22'
ORDER BY a.startTime ASC
LIMIT 20;
